## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -16.04%) BELOW TREND and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) ↑ reflation signal, with Stocks vs Bonds mildly positive (SPY (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.86%) CORRECTION vs TLT (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND) as confirming signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX falling (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -16.04%) BELOW TREND. Reflation/commodity bid: CPER rising (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND. Credit flag mixed: HYG (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +0.71%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.15% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND — HYG/LQD signal flagged CREDIT STRESS ↑.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Dollar showing RECOVERY (Dollar Level: 1W: +0.33% | 1M: -0.41%) ↑ rising while duration preference and yield curve remain BELOW TREND; TLT (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND signals slightly tighter conditions.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) and XAR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +14.28%) showing strength. Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.11%) and XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -0.19% | 1M: -1.78%) showing weakness; style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?  
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.86%) while EM/Emerging FXI/EEM leading — FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.57% | 1M: +2.94%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.76% | 1M: +6.13%) ↑ rising versus US.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation healthy: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +1.37%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +0.73%) with IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +1.58%) in RECOVERY — risk-on flows into higher-beta assets.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Base metals and industrial commodities strong: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) and DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.42% | 1M: +10.30%) indicating reflation. Precious metals showing short-term profit taking: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -1.91% | 1M: +5.66%) and SLV CORRECTION (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +30.17%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy cyclicals robust: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) and BNO RECOVERY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -0.86%). Natural gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -24.82%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Commodities/energy (CPER and XLE) both ABOVE TREND and VXX falling confirm risk-on tilt. DIVERGENCE: Tech (XLK BELOW TREND) vs Financials/Industrials (sector breadth positive) signals sector rotation rather than broad-based tech-led advance.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposures such as XLE (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND and XAR (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +14.28%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.11%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -0.95% | 1M: -0.76%) BELOW TREND while monitoring credit spreads and bonds (TLT BELOW TREND).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials ITA (1W: +3.86% | 1M: +12.33%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Tech XLK (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.11%) BELOW TREND; Utilities XLU (1W: -0.19% | 1M: -1.78%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) and DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.42% | 1M: +10.30%). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -24.82%) and gold GLD CORRECTION (1W: -1.91% | 1M: +5.66%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency trigger), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF spread ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot), CPER trend break above recent highs to confirm reflation momentum.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Energy and industrials showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%), XAR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +14.28%)). Key risk: sector rotation and credit signal divergence (HYG vs LQD) with Tech (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.11%)) the main divergence to monitor.
